narratives.Description: Upgrade the maintained training baseline from @deftai/directive 0.111.0 to the exact 0.112.0 release across dependencies, executable proofs, and current teaching references.
narratives.UserStory: As a 3Ci Directive learner or maintainer, I want the repository's current guidance and executable examples to agree on the latest pinned release, so that the training does not mix framework generations or repeat behavior that changed upstream.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Bind release identity to npm 0.112.0, its integrity, annotated tag, peeled commit, and installed CLI/core/content/types graph.
2. Update package pins, fixture overrides, focused assertions, and platform workflow expectations.
3. Re-run the disposable consumer path on macOS/zsh and compare 0.112.0 behavior with the maintained disagreements.
4. Update current source-baseline, source-notes, modules, labs, solutions, quick reference, glossary, README, and maintenance guidance.
5. Preserve historical 0.111.0 delivery records byte-for-byte, run focused checks and task deft:check, and require native CI before claiming Linux/Windows 0.112.0 revalidation.
narratives.Acceptance: All maintained package and executable surfaces pin 0.112.0 exactly; current learner and maintainer references describe only behavior observed or sourced from 0.112.0; the fixed approved-scope separator disagreement is removed; still-present defects remain explicit; historical completed and archived 0.111.0 evidence is unchanged; local macOS proof and repository quality gates pass; and Linux/Windows status is not promoted to revalidated without a successful native matrix run.
narratives.Safety: All runtime probing stays inside unique operating-system temporary directories with fictional data and no Git remote. No command may mutate the training worktree, a business repository, upstream deftai/directive, credentials, production systems, or publishing surfaces.
narratives.Traces: PROJECT-DEFINITION DirectiveBaseline, SourceOfTruth, SupportedEnvironments, LabModel, Maintenance, RisksAndUnknowns, ProjectRules, and David's explicit full-upgrade instruction.
narratives.QualityGate: Run npm run check:cold-start-readme, npm run check:modules-2-3, directive verify:vbrief-conformance --project-root ., and task deft:check. Native Linux/bash and Windows/PowerShell 7 status requires the modules-2-3-platform-validation GitHub Actions matrix on the final branch head.
